name: Text Viewer
notes: Bundled headed App (CodeMirror, esbuild-built from frontend-src/ — see build.sh). Reads via the served URL, saves through the bridge fs broker.

actions.name: getText
actions.description: Read the text currently visible/editable in this window, including unsaved edits. Supports offset and limit (1–100000).

actions.name: replaceText
actions.description: Replace the current document in this window without saving. Optional expectedText prevents overwriting intervening edits.

actions.name: save
actions.description: Save the current editor contents to its workspace file and report actual write failures.
